R-C21-1.source: (xs) => { let best = 0, cur = 0; for (let i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) { cur = i > 0 && xs[i] >= xs[i - 1] ? cur + 1 : 1; best = Math.max(best, cur); } return best; }

R-C23-1.source: (xs, k) => { if (k < 1 || k > xs.length) return null; let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) s += xs[i]; let b = s; for (let i = k; i < xs.length; i++) { s += xs[i] - xs[i - k]; b = Math.min(b, s); } return b; }

R-C35-1.source: (g, r, c) => { if (g[r][c] !== 1) return 0; const seen = new Set([`${r},${c}`]); const st = [[r, c]]; while (st.length) { const [a, b] = st.pop(); for (const [da, db] of [[1, 0], [-1, 0], [0, 1], [0, -1]]) { const x = a + da, y = b + db; if (g[x]?.[y] === 1 && !seen.has(`${x},${y}`)) { seen.add(`${x},${y}`); st.push([x, y]); } } } return seen.size; }

R-C36-1.source: (nb, s, g) => { const seen = new Set([s]); const st = [s]; while (st.length) { const c = st.pop(); if (c === g) return true; for (const x of nb[c]) if (!seen.has(x)) { seen.add(x); st.push(x); } } return false; }

R-C37-1.source: (ls) => { const out = [], cur = [], used = ls.map(() => false); const go = () => { if (cur.length === ls.length) { out.push([...cur]); return; } for (let i = 0; i < ls.length; i++) { if (used[i]) continue; used[i] = true; cur.push(ls[i]); go(); cur.pop(); used[i] = false; } }; go(); return out; }
